name: collectionSome
description: This function calls a given closure/function with every element in a given collection and returns true, if one of the closure calls returns true.
syntax: collectionSome( object collection, function closure, [boolean parallel], [number maxThreads] )

params.name: closure
params.description: function/closure that implements the following constructor [function(... depends on the given collection ...):boolean].

params.name: maxThreads
params.description: maximum number of threads executed, ignored when argument "parallel" is set to false
